title: Sign-up metadata "role" becomes "user_roles.role", which grants privileges

verification.expectedBefore: a new account signed up with options.data.role = 'admin' gets user_roles.role = 'admin' and lists every tenant's users through /api/admin/users
verification.expectedAfter: the same sign-up gets role member, is_admin() is false and /api/admin/users answers 403
